description: Same as chat_research_session but returns a job immediately; use when the answer may take longer than the client's tool timeout. For findings, feedback, comparisons and quotations from your User Intuition studies, use this tool; answers are grounded in document search over the session sources with verified quotations. Resolve ambiguous study names first. Reuse the selected research session; if absent create one with create_research_session and a stable retry key, inspect sources and add only missing requested studies. Do not resync unchanged sources or broaden the session silently. After completion always call view_research_answer to display the answer and clickable quote/recording cards inside this conversation, without redirecting to a dashboard; preserve the answer and citation labels. Poll inspect_research_session view=job. Set parent_job_id for a follow-up in the same session. Reuse the same idempotency_key and prompt after a timeout; sync and async share the job.

idempotency_key.description: Use a stable key for this operation and reuse it on retries with the same inputs.

include_synthetic.description: Include evidence from synthetic respondents alongside human interviews.

organization_id.description: Organization for this operation and billing. Use list_organizations to choose an active membership.

parent_job_id.description: Completed chat job to continue with a follow-up in this session.

prompt.description: Natural-language question or instructions for the requested research task.

session_id.description: UUID of the research session, as returned by inspect_research_session.
